hero.eyebrow: Foster-based cat rescue in North Florida
hero.text: Feline Fairies is a volunteer-run rescue in St. Augustine. We give homeless cats and kittens safe foster homes, basic medical care, and a path to the families who will love them for life.

image.alt: Ginger cat and gray kitten resting together on a sofa in an illustrative foster-home scene

intro.text: Our cats live in foster homes while volunteers help them grow comfortable, cared for, and ready for adoption.

mission.title: A soft place to land. A chance to belong.
paragraphs: From tiny kittens to senior companions, our volunteers rescue homeless, abandoned, and at-risk cats. Foster homes provide daily care, comfort, and socialization while the rescue arranges basic medical care and works to find each cat a loving family.
Every adoption makes room for another cat who needs us.

image.alt: Calico cat resting in a person’s lap in an illustrative foster-home scene

paths.eyebrow: Find your place in the story
paths.title: Their next chapter could start with you.
paths.text: However you choose to help, you become part of a cat’s second chance.

items.title: Adopt
items.text: Meet cats and kittens looking for a family. Find the companion who feels like yours, then take the next step toward bringing them home.

items.title: Foster
items.text: Open your home to a cat while they wait for adoption. Whether it’s your first time or your tenth, the rescue will help you get started.

items.title: Volunteer
items.text: Help at events, spend time with cats, support transport, or lend your skills behind the scenes. There is room for many kinds of helping hands.

steps.title: Adoption begins with a connection.
steps.text: We want every cat and family to have the best possible start together.

items.title: Meet the cats
items.text: Browse the cats and kittens currently looking for homes.

items.title: Apply to adopt
items.text: Share a little about your home and the companion you hope to meet.

items.title: Plan a visit
items.text: After application approval, a meet-and-greet can be scheduled.

donation.title: You can help make room for the next rescue.
donation.text: Donations support foster-based care, basic medical care, and the everyday needs of cats and kittens as they wait for a family.
